audit.whatIsWrong: Content chart reads Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere against the packet's Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Tryndamere. The full-layer phases carry the same five errors, and phases[3]/[4] sit at 4/10 on stages the prose says Gragas wins.
audit.why: The packet chart is exactly what the page's own text says. whys[1]: 'flips the return trade in your favour' — Gragas, marked Tryndamere. whys[2]: 'play even, don't over-commit' — Skill, marked Tryndamere. whys[3]: 'a sustained-trade edge his crit poke can't out-grind' — Gragas, marked Skill. whys[4]: 'a real all-in' — Gragas, marked Skill. whys[5]: 'your peak duel window' — Gragas, marked Tryndamere. Only the last row, where full-crit Tryndamere takes the side lane, was already right. As it stands the chart hands Tryndamere five stages the prose beneath it says belong to Gragas, on a 52.53% win rate.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Tryndamere, with phases[3] and phases[4] raised to 6/10.

audit.why: Spike order is right and unusually well written already: Gragas at 2 on the Drunken Rage auto plus Happy Hour, 6 on Body Slam into Explosive Cask, first item on Riftmaker plus Morellonomicon anti-heal, then Tryndamere past two items. Undying Rage's 120/100/80 is the timing the spikes hang on and was missing — now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout is described only as 'W-slow your retreat', with its conditional never stated; Undying Rage appears everywhere as 'Unkillable 5s' with no cooldown; Spinning Slash's cooldown and zero cost are never given; and dontsFull[1] pairs the heading 'Grind his spin' with generic filler about burning a tool 'for tiny value'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Mocking Shout decreases surrounding champions' ATTACK DAMAGE, and 'enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere ALSO have their Move Speed reduced'. Two consequences the page never gives the player: the AD reduction is worthless against an AP Gragas, and the slow is conditional — walk away and you are slowed, back off facing him and you are not. That is the difference between escaping a spent Body Slam and dying to it. Spinning Slash is free (0 cost) on 12/11/10/9/8 at 650 range, against Gragas's 14s Body Slam — he pays nothing to close and you pay everything to miss. Undying Rage is 120/100/80, the number that decides whether the level-6 all-in is on.
audit.corrected: Mocking Shout: 14s, 850 range, cuts AD (irrelevant to AP Gragas) and slows only enemies with their backs turned. Spinning Slash: free, 12s at rank 1 down to 8s, 650 range. Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3.
sources: enemyKit W/E/R text, cd, range, cost

audit.whatIsWrong: 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan'.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1. The punish is sharper than the page says: his Spinning Slash is free and back up in 12s, so a whiffed Body Slam gives him a gap-close you cannot answer.
audit.corrected: 14 seconds at rank 1, against a free 12s Spinning Slash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing tells the player Mocking Shout's slow requires their back to be turned.
audit.why: It is the one piece of counterplay that changes how you leave a trade, and it is invisible in every guide that just calls W 'a slow'.

edits.after: Full kit online, but a whiffed 14s Body Slam invites his free 12s Spinning Slash — hold the wave near your own side.

notes: Cleanest entry in the slice on prose — the Cask-during-Undying-Rage sequencing and the Morellonomicon timing were already right, so the work was the chart and the missing numbers. Left alone as unverifiable from the kits: the '5 seconds' duration of Undying Rage (Riot's text gives no duration, so the existing claim stands untouched rather than being restated as fact), and the 'infinite spin' framing in wants.foe[2], which implies a crit-based Spinning Slash cooldown refund that does not appear in the ability text. Also not asserted: whether Explosive Cask's knockback can displace Tryndamere mid-Undying-Rage or mid-spin, and whether the Body Slam stun is shortened by tenacity inside his Rage window. Sample note: brief.games says 1041, packet.games says 396 — worth checking the packet builder.
